tagline: Built with love by Filipe Leitão.
bio1: Filipe Leitão is a composer, music producer, and professor focused on music for film, games, and media.
bio2: This app helps you shape ideas, explore directions, and improve your tracks through practical techniques.
bio3: The "Listen & Build" examples are original compositions, written and produced by Filipe Leitão.
closing: Build better music by thinking musically.
